4186-4279-7918.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-7918.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

7084-7201-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7201-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4446-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-4446-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

654-1021-5414-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat.

3881-4702-7515.easyPrerequisites:
Blistercoil Weird doesn't have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin is attached to Blistercoil Weird.
3881-4702-7515.description:
Activate Blistercoil Weird using the ability granted to it by Splinter Twin by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {W}.
Cast a copy of Scrollboost by paying {W}, targeting any valid target(s).
Blistercoil Weird triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping it.
Resolve Scrollboost, giving up to two creatures +2/+2 each until end of turn.
Repeat.

5078-5741-7175-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6006-6248--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6006-6248--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-4365-4826-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1325-2452-3249-5670--56.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1325-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1594-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Repeat

4067-5003-5147-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
4067-5003-5147-7848.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
4067-5003-5147-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

2034-3755-5295-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-969-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-969-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-969-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

643-5010-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Golgari Thug's power, which will cause you to mill Golgari Thug.
As Golgari Thug is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Golgari Thug from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4871-5434-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7606.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

586-2292-4871-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

457-1792-4404-6967.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-6967.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

413-677-4217-5211.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
413-677-4217-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Lutri trigger, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lutri.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
413-677-4217-5211.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

1479-2841-5671-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-5671-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

57-4359-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4359-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3490-7062.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Aang triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

5220-5686-6539-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4636-5770-6753.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating six 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers six times, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat.

2425-5147-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-5147-6249--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

955-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

397-2403-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-2403-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

1786-6033.description:
Cast Marina Vendrell's Grimoire by paying {5}{U}.
When Marina Vendrell's Grimoire enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw five cards.
Queza triggers five times.
Resolve the first Queza trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 5.
1786-6033.notes: This combo will result in you eventually drawing from an empty library, thus losing the game. It is highly recommended to have a way to stop the combo at instant speed or to otherwise stop yourself from losing the game.

1741-3478-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1741-3478-5900.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Dimir Aqueduct and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

293-2511-5220-5716.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2867-3433-4871-5147.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment four times by sacrificing Hornet Queen and three Insect tokens.
When Hornet Queen and the Insect tokens die, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability and Pitiless Plunderer each trigger four times.
Resolve all Demon of Dark Schemes triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve all Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 4 damage to any target.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Hornet Queen from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1550-1849-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-1849-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

437-2757-4433.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control at least one basic land.
437-2757-4433.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Sphinx's Disciple, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Immobilizing Ink by paying {1} and discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

648-3173.notablePrerequisites: Your library size is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
648-3173.description:
Cast Body of Reaserch by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to your library size.
Cast Fling by paying {1}{R} and sacrificing the Fractal, dealing damage equal to the Fractal's power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1744-3096-3994-4655.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other Golems.
1744-3096-3994-4655.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Shadow Rift by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems each trigger.
Resolve the first Percursor Golem trigger, creating a copy of Shadow Rift targeting every other Golem.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the first Shadow Rift, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 10 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

141-3269-5256.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Ascend from Avernus.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing target player to mill cards equal to Naru Meha's power.
Resolve the copy of Ascend from Avernus, returning all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value four or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
